reason: The proposed modify_pending_order_items call attempts to remove items by providing an empty new_item_ids array. The policy explicitly defines modification as: 'each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.' Item removal—replacing items with nothing—is not a modification to an available variant; it is deletion. The policy does not authorize partial item removal from pending orders through modification. The only cancellation mechanism in policy is cancel_pending_order, which cancels the entire order with a required reason ('no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake'), not individual items. The user confirmed removing items, but the policy's modify operation requires replacement with a different product variant, not removal.
policy_references: Modify items: 'each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option'
For a pending order, you can take actions to modify its shipping address, payment method, or product item options, but nothing else.
Cancel pending order requires order-level cancellation with specific reasons; no partial item removal is documented
